Version 1 – 31.01.2018 MREC06/Q0104/133
10. Please indicate what your headaches usually feel like: (tick all that apply):
⃝ Throbbing/Pulsing ⃝ Dull ⃝ Shooting
⃝ Achy ⃝ Stabbing ⃝ Burning
⃝ Tight ⃝ Pressure ⃝ Other: 
__________________________________
11. How long do your headaches last in HOURS?
Shortest ___ Longest ___ Average ____ or are they constant? ⃝ No ⃝ Yes
12. Please indicate when your headaches are worst:
 ⃝ Morning ⃝ Afternoon ⃝ Evening ⃝ During the night ⃝ No pattern
13. Are your headaches worse lying down or standing? 0 Lying down ⃝ Standing ⃝ Both the same
14. Do your headaches wake you up in the middle of the night? 0 No ⃝ Yes → if yes, how often? 
__________________
15. Do you experience any of these symptoms 1 to 2 days before the onset of headache? Please tick all that apply.
⃝ Hyperactivity ⃝ Difficulty with speech ⃝ Food cravings
⃝ Depressed feeling ⃝ Sensitive to light ⃝ Increased appetite
⃝ Irritability ⃝ Sensitive to sound/noise ⃝ Decreased appetite
⃝ Feeling sluggish ⃝ Dizziness ⃝ Increased urination
⃝ Difficulty concentrating ⃝ Excessive yawning ⃝ Stiff neck
⃝ Other: 
________________________________________________________________________
16. Do you experience any of these symptoms during your headache? Please tick all that apply.
⃝ Nausea or upset stomach/vomiting ⃝ Sensitivity to smells
⃝ Sensitivity to light (prefer a dark room) ⃝ Difficulty thinking/concentrating/focusing
⃝ Sensitivity to sound (prefer a quiet room) ⃝ Difficulty speaking/slurred speech
⃝ Sore/stiff neck ⃝ Increased Urination
⃝ Vision changes (blurred, spots, patterns) ⃝ Anxiety
⃝ Eye tearing in only ONE EYE ⃝ Irritability
⃝ Runny nose in only ONE NOSTRIL ⃝ Memory problems
⃝ Ringing in ears ⃝ Increased appetite
⃝ Eye-redness [☐ Right ☐ Left] ⃝ Decreased appetite
⃝ Drooping eyelid [☐ Right ☐ Left] ⃝ Diarrhoea
⃝ Swelling of eyelid [☐ Right ☐ Left] ⃝ Constipation
⃝ Change in pupil [☐ Larger ☐ Smaller] ⃝ Insomnia
⃝ Dizziness/vertigo ⃝ Sleepiness
⃝ Imbalance
⃝ Confusion
⃝ Numbness/Tingling [Where? 
___________________ ]
⃝ Stroke like symptoms (facial droop, droopy eyelid, unable to move one arm or leg)
⃝ Other: 
____________________________________________________________________________
